name: agent-ops
description: Running a governed agent over long horizons — working memory that survives a context reset, deliberate handoffs, sub-agent dispatch, and the substrate a repo needs before an agent can work in it.

$excluded.handoff-auto: Superseded by agent-notepad, which says so in its own description and whose installer unwires it. Both are still shipped so an existing install does not break, but a NEW kit naming both would install two hook suites competing for the same events. ⚠️ They also carry two forks of one hardened redactor (lib/redact.sh, differing only in header comments) — a redactor that drifts fails silently, and that is worth resolving before either is bundled again.
